description: This file contains a data migration class for OrchardCore, specifically handling the creation and updating of content item titles, including schema alterations and data patching logic.

classes.name: Migrations
classes.description: A data migration class for managing content title parts and patching existing content items.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates the TitlePart schema with description and default position.

methods.name: UpdateFrom1
methods.description: Updates existing content items by migrating Title to DisplayText, processing in batches.

methods.name: UpdateTitle
methods.description: Recursively updates the content JSON object, moving Title to DisplayText if present.
